question.:question/problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{1}{2x}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
To plot $y=\frac{1}{2x},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=\frac{1}{x}.$

![](images/a3/a32495fcca947d01cf8d3218fc5cfc0cce083a34e6fb6b629d92ba9e47039a6e.png)

- Stretch the result by a scale factor of $\frac{1}{2}$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=\frac{1}{2x}.$

![](images/f3/f3a1cac41b2f9d6773226d76722508e6d7f368a42a0f7e86a5d8407d6f42c149.png)
